label: OTP
title: OTP
summary: Use OTP to enter a one-time verification code, one digit per slot, with an optional resend timer.
corePrinciple: One digit per slot. The screen checks the code; OTP only shows the result.

sizing.title: Fills its container, slots up to 48 px
sizing.description: OTP fills its container. Slots are up to 48 px wide with 8 px gaps, plus 8 px padding, so 6 digits need 344 px at full size. In a narrower container the slots shrink: 8 digits fit a 334 px phone column at about 33 px each. In a wider one, slots stay 48 px at the left.

inContext.title: Verifying a phone number
inContext.description: The screen keeps the code, checks it when the last digit is entered, and sets the error. On phones, the keyboard offers the SMS code automatically. Enter 123456 to see success, anything else to see the error.

sources.title: Use the public OTP contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (16 October build) from the team’s private package repository. Figma and the package agree on 48 px slots and 8 px gaps, and on a right-aligned support line with a small Resend button. In code the slots shrink in a narrow container, so all of Storybook’s 4–8 digit lengths fit a phone. Since the #274 fix, longer support or error text wraps inside the field, while short text stays right-aligned. OTP has no verifying state; the screen checks the code and sets the error.
